# ComplexSystemMemory

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The emergent memory properties arising from the collective dynamics of interconnected components in a complex network. Bridges network topology and neuromorphic computing, enabling memory functions to be embedded in the physical interconnect structure.
